items.title: 19.6.1 Difference between Translation in Prokaryotes and Eukaryotes (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu comparison of translation in prokaryotes and eukaryotes (PDF 140).

blocks.caption: Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes mein translation ka farq
rows: Prokaryotic genes mein introns nahin hote.
Zyada tar eukaryotic genes mein introns hote hain.
Transcription ke foran baad mRNA ki translation ho jati hai; mRNA mein transcription ke baad koi tabdeeli nahin hoti.
Translation se pehle mRNA badla jata hai: introns kaat diye jate hain, 5′ cap lagta hai aur 3′ poly-A tail lagti hai.
Translation cytoplasm mein bhi hoti hai aur rough endoplasmic reticulum par bhi.
Pehla amino acid badla hua hota hai, yaani N-formyl methionine.
Pehla amino acid methionine hai, bina badla.

blocks.prompt: Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic translation mein do farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: ribosomes 70S ya 80S; pehla amino acid N-formyl methionine ya methionine; mRNA mein koi tabdeeli nahin, ya 5′ cap, 3′ poly-A tail aur introns ki splicing; translation sirf cytoplasm mein, ya cytoplasm aur rough ER par.

items: Prokaryotes: introns nahin, 70S, N-formyl methionine, mRNA foran translate.
Eukaryotes: introns, 80S, methionine, mRNA pehle tayyar (cap, tail, splicing).
